opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search
opportunities.description: On Ryanair, search for flights from a given origin to a given destination on given outbound/return dates (optionally with a promo code) and select fares.
steps: Open the Ryanair flight search widget
Set 'From' by typing the city or picking country then airport
Set 'To' by typing the city or picking country then airport
Open the date picker, go to the right month and click the outbound date
Click the return date (or choose one-way)
Optionally click 'Apply promo code' and enter the code
Click 'Select' on the outbound and return flights you want

instances.values: To=Athens (Greece); dates in Apr/May (2, 5); flights selected
Tel Aviv -> Venice Treviso; May 9 - May 16; flights selected, fare upgrade viewed

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant availability notification
opportunities.description: On Resy, search for a restaurant and set a 'Notify' alert for a given date, party size, meal and time window.
steps: Type the restaurant name or cuisine into 'Search restaurants, cuisines, etc.'
Optionally change the date and select the number of guests
Optionally set the preferred time window and click 'Confirm'

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, search for attractions at a destination on a given date and open one to check availability.
steps: Type the destination or attraction in 'Where are you going?' (or browse by region) and pick the suggestion
Click 'Select your dates' and choose the date
Optionally apply filters or sorting (e.g. 'Most popular')
Open an attraction, click 'See availability', choose the date and ticket quantities, then click 'Next'

instances.values: Asia -> Kyoto; 25 May 2023; sorted Most popular; availability checked, tickets set, Next (with a break for other browsing)
